scripts.dev: npm run desktop:prepare && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE vite
scripts.build: npm run desktop:prepare && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.build:check: vue-tsc && npm run test:boundaries && npm run desktop:prepare && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.test: npm run test:boundaries && node --import tsx tests/run.ts
scripts.test:desktop-runtime: npm run desktop:prepare && node --import tsx scripts/check-desktop-runtime.ts
scripts.test:faults: node --import tsx tests/run.ts tests/platform/diagnostics.spec.ts tests/backend/adapters/http/error-boundary.spec.ts tests/backend/execution/host.spec.ts tests/backend/adapters/messaging/queue.spec.ts tests/client/stream.spec.ts tests/client/session.spec.ts tests/apps/desktop/ipc-handlers.spec.ts tests/apps/desktop/local-service-process.spec.ts
